metadata.description: The TRIP development workflow, a Karpathy-style LLM-wiki for project memory, prompt-driven Codex delegation, and a curated set of Matt Pocock's engineering skills.

plugins.name: trip
plugins.description: Plan / Implement / Review / Test workflow with versioned docs, changelog and release ceremony.

plugins.name: trip-wiki
plugins.description: Project memory as an LLM wiki: atomic linked pages under docs/archi/ instead of one monolithic ARCHI.md.

plugins.name: codex-bridge
plugins.description: Prompt-driven Codex delegation: plan review, code review, implementation and second opinions, with TRIP verdict tags.

plugins.name: pocock-core
plugins.description: A vendored subset of Matt Pocock's engineering skills: grilling, specs, tickets, triage, research, teaching and wayfinding.

plugins.name: toolbox
plugins.description: Small standalone helpers: Conventional Commits with no AI attribution, plus short-form exploration and debugging commands.
